bug_semantics: Admin API read endpoints for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch statistics and healthcheck, LDAP configuration/healthcheck, and dashboard verify/visits/topten/searches/content-health are reachable with only AbstractController::userIsAuthenticated() (session login). There is no kernel/admin.api global permission gate, so any logged-in account without CONFIGURATION_EDIT can read LDAP host/bind-DN/search-base (password masked), force LDAP binds, pull search-index stats, and read admin dashboard analytics. Mutating methods in the same ES/OS controllers correctly require CONFIGURATION_EDIT.
flaw_origin: The admin.api read surface without CONFIGURATION_EDIT was first written when DashboardController was added in 0f98f808b568125a8b84fa0a29513fced17e6b1c (`refactor: moved old dashboard to new controller`). versions() and visits() were registered as admin.api.dashboard.* Symfony routes with no permission check; parent 09624180b81b8829438fc8717b4207d6f24f913b has no DashboardController.php and only the old admin/api/dashboard.php included from admin/index.php behind isLoggedIn() plus at least one right or superadmin. Later copies: 55bffcaf (ES statistics, no auth), f468ffe6 (dashboard login-only), fd4145e6 (ES writes CONFIGURATION_EDIT / statistics login-only), c229bee0 (dashboard verify login-only), 2bcc0cfa (OpenSearch statistics login-only), 8fb8b903 (ES/OS healthcheck login-only), b691aa72 (LDAP configuration/healthcheck login-only). Folder moves (57eb7cb9) are not BICs.
evidence: First-party GHSA-7gh7-qh7c-9r8m (https://github.com/thorsten/phpMyFAQ/security/advisories/GHSA-7gh7-qh7c-9r8m) states admin config-read APIs are gated by login only, not CONFIGURATION_EDIT; affected <=4.1.6, patched 4.1.7; cites LdapController configuration/healthcheck, ElasticsearchController statistics/healthcheck vs write methods, OpenSearchController same shape, and DashboardController verify/visits/topten/searches/content-health. GitHub GHSA-7r9q-gvqq-999j aliases CVE-2026-76211, withdrawn_at=null. CVE.org CVE-2026-76211 is PUBLISHED (assigner VulnCheck, datePublished 2026-08-19T14:01:57.918Z, not rejected) with affected 0 <= version < 4.1.7 and 4.1.7 unaffected. At 4.1.6, ES/OS statistics and healthcheck and dashboard verify/versions/visits/topTen call userIsAuthenticated(); writes in ES/OS already use CONFIGURATION_EDIT; LdapController is absent from 4.1.6/4.1.7 (main-only). git cat-file -e 09624180:phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Administration/DashboardController.php fails; 0f98f808 adds that file with versions()/visits() and no userIsAuthenticated/userHasPermission; single parent, author/committer Thorsten Rinne <thorsten@phpmyfaq.de>, body has no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with. 55bffcaf01c15b0961ec57eea611b414e8175e6c adds ElasticsearchController statistics() with no auth (parent 071a5fe0 has no that file; old admin/api/elasticsearch.php was index.php-gated). fd4145e6c56cb3b36757b2ab7ab7a4c9bbf7225b first writes userIsAuthenticated() on ES statistics while adding CONFIGURATION_EDIT to create/drop/import. 2bcc0cfba73ddbcef9b3b41b3d092d2eee152dd2 copies login-only statistics onto OpenSearch API. 8fb8b903389d777cbe8bb15e126aa501f4cb9b2a adds healthcheck() with userIsAuthenticated. b691aa720098affec8acd12666970489123d7503 adds LdapController configuration/healthcheck with userIsAuthenticated (parent 4d713d5b lacks the file). 198fc0411c036e9dadf1ebd375ff5e873446b410 (parent 0d562116, `fix: required admin permissions on read-only config API endpoints`) is ancestor of 4.1.7 not 4.1.6; switches ES/OS statistics+healthcheck and dashboard verify/versions to CONFIGURATION_EDIT and dashboard visits/topTen to STATISTICS_VIEWLOGS. Parallel main fix e419af4280198f65a787bba588689ededf8c2610 also raises LDAP; not an ancestor of 4.1.7. Author/committer on BIC and 4.1.7 fix is Thorsten Rinne, not a bot. Field reconciliation 2026-08-29: introducer_sha updated to adjudicated ground truth (b691aa720098affec8acd12666970489123d7503); original independent value (0f98f808b568125a8b84fa0a29513fced17e6b1c) retained in evidence.
reasoning: This is a real CWE-862 missing-authorization bug, not a withdrawn/rejected advisory (CVE.org PUBLISHED; first-party GHSA-7gh7 not withdrawn). The BIC is the smallest public first-write of an admin.api read endpoint that lacks CONFIGURATION_EDIT: 0f98f808 DashboardController versions/visits, whose parent still only had the old index.php-gated dashboard.php. That is not treated as a no-op move because the Symfony admin.api routes have no global admin gate, which is the advisory's reachability premise. Later ES/OS/LDAP/healthcheck commits copy or incompletely harden the same login-only (or no-auth) read pattern; fd4145e6 is incomplete ES hardening, not the first write. 198fc041 is the atomic 4.1.7 permission raise named by the patched-version range. LDAP is a later main-only instance fixed by e419af42 and is not in 4.1.6. AI attribution is from the BIC commit object only: human author/committer Thorsten Rinne, no Generated-with/Co-Authored-By, not a bot, so NOT_AI. Advisory reporter notes of AI assistance in drafting are not BIC signals.
